# Draft:Battle of Wiwilí

The Battle of Wiwilí refers to two armed clashes during the Contra War that took place near the town of Wiwilí in 1983 and 1986.
Background
Wiwilí was located in a region frequently affected by clashes between Contra forces and Sandinista troops.
Engagements
The two engagements involved attacks on government positions followed by Contra withdrawals.
Aftermath
Sandinista forces retained control of the town after both incidents.
